title: mcsets
description: Commerce and payment infrastructure for digital creators. Build branded stores, accept payments, & manage revenue all in one place.
body:
# Overview

McSets is a webstore integration plugin that connects your server to a McSets store.

It allows you to sell packages, subscriptions, and other content through a web-based storefront, with actions automatically executed in-game after a purchase is completed.

## Functionality

* Syncs your server with your McSets webstore
* Automatically processes purchases and delivers rewards in-game
* Supports commands, ranks, permissions, and other server actions
* Handles purchases while players are offline (executed when they next join)

## How it works

1. Create and configure your store on McSets
2. Install the plugin on your server
3. Link your server using your store key
4. Define what commands/actions should run for each package
5. Orders are processed automatically and applied to players

## Features

**Automated delivery**
Purchases made on your store are automatically fulfilled in-game without manual input.

**Command-based system**
Run server commands on purchase (e.g. giving items, assigning ranks, permissions).

**Offline support**
Orders are queued and delivered when the player next joins if they are not online.

**Centralised store management**
All packages, pricing, and configuration are managed through your McSets dashboard.

## Setup

1. Download and place the plugin in your `/plugins` folder
2. Restart your server
3. Set your API key in the plugins config.yml
4. Restart your server
5. Verify connection via the dashboard

## Notes

* Requires a McSets account and active store
* Payment processing and storefront are handled externally via McSets
* Plugin is responsible for syncing and executing in-game actions only

## Support

* Website: https://mcsets.com
* Documentation: https://mcsets.com/docs
* Support: https://mcsets.com/contact
